A Complete Guide to Visit Saigon Opera House Ho Chi Minh City

# A Complete Guide to Visit Saigon Opera House Ho Chi Minh City


Saigon Opera House Ho Chi Minh city, also known as the Ho Chi Minh City Municipal Theatre, is one of the most stunning French colonial landmarks in Vietnam. Located in the heart of District 1, this architecture is a must-visit for those interested in history, culture, and the arts. Here's everything you need to know about visiting the Saigon Opera House.



#### Table of Contents

1. [1\. Overview about The Hanoi Opera House](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/travel/travel-guide/saigon-opera-house-ho-chi-minh-city#1.-overview-about-the-hanoi-opera-house)

## 1\. Overview about The Hanoi Opera House

Located in the heart of the capital, **The Hanoi Opera House** is not only an architectural masterpiece but also a symbol of French colonial heritage in Vietnam. This landmark has become a cultural icon where art and history intertwine. Whether you're an architecture enthusiast or a lover of classical music, the Opera House offers a unique glimpse into Hanoi’s vibrant past and artistic present.

### 1.1. Location

The Opera House in Hanoi is located at [1 Trang Tien Street, Hoan Kiem District](https://maps.app.goo.gl/C6gvRherj6KYLLHLA), the prime location that allows visitors to easily reach the theater from various directions. Surrounded by major streets such as Trang Tien, Ly Thai To, and Le Thanh Tong, the area is bustling with shops, restaurants, hotels, and other popular tourist attractions, making it a convenient and lively destination for both sightseeing and cultural exploration.

Located just about 500 meters from Hoan Kiem Lake, one of Hanoi’s most iconic landmarks, the Hanoi Opera House is easily reachable on foot. Amidst the hustle and bustle of tall buildings and lively streets, the theater stands out as a striking symbol of elegance and cultural heritage.

![You can find your way to the iconic Hanoi Opera House with this detailed map](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/you-can-find-your-way-to-the-iconic-hanoi-opera-house-with-this-detailed-map.jpeg)

_You can find your way to the iconic Hanoi Opera House with this detailed map_

### 1.2. Opening Hours and Entrance Fees

The Hanoi Opera House is open for guided tours every day of the week, from **10:30 AM to 12:00 PM**, while evening performances usually begin from **7:30 PM onward**. However, schedules may vary depending on special events or private bookings. Visitors are encouraged to check the official website for the latest updates before planning their visit.

Ticket prices depend on the type of event. The entrance fee to the Opera House is **120,000 VND per person**, which includes access to the main hall and exhibition areas but may not cover backstage tours or premium seating. For live concerts, operas, and ballet performances, ticket prices range from **300,000 VND to over 1,500,000 VND**, depending on seat location and event scale.

Exclusive performances or VIP experiences may have higher rates. It’s best to book in advance to secure preferred seating.

### 1.3. Best Transport Options to Reach The Opera House

Located on Trang Tien Street, near Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Opera House enjoys a prime location, making it easily accessible from various parts of the city. Visitors can choose from a variety of transportation options to get here, including motorbikes, taxis, and public buses.

- **By motorbike**: Visitors can ride their own motorbikes or rent one from nearby shops. Motorcycle parking is available on Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hoan Kiem District, with a parking fee of approximately 10,000 VND, but spaces can be limited during peak hours.
- **By taxi or ride-hailing apps**: For those unfamiliar with the roads, taking a taxi or using a ride-hailing app is the most convenient option. This method ensures a direct and hassle-free journey, especially for tourists who prefer comfort and ease.
- **By bus**: Several bus routes stop near the Opera House, making public transport an affordable choice. Visitors can take buses No. 11, 31, 34, 40, 49, 146, 35A, 86CT. For those traveling from the West Lake area, opt for bus No. 02, 04, and E02. Be sure to check real-time schedules to avoid long waiting times.

![There are several bus stops located near the Hanoi Opera House – a budget-friendly ride (Source: Xe Buýt Hà Nội - Transerco)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/there-are-several-bus-stops-located-near-the-hanoi-opera-house-a-budget-friendly-ride.png)

_There are several bus stops located near the Hanoi Opera House – a budget-friendly ride_ _(Source: Xe Buýt Hà Nội - Transerco)_

## 2\. The Captivating History behind The Hanoi Opera House

The Hanoi Opera House was built in 1901 by the French colonial administration and officially completed in 1911. Inspired by the Palais Garnier in Paris, it underwent a significant renovation from 1995 to 1997 to restore its architectural beauty. Today, the opera house stands as a cultural landmark, hosting numerous prestigious performances and national events.

Beyond its architectural grandeur, the Hanoi Opera House has witnessed many historical milestones. During the entire decade of the 1940s, particularly in the lead-up to the uprising and following the August Revolution, the Hanoi Opera House often served as a site for mass meetings, displays of force, and significant political gatherings .

Over time, the Opera House became a glorious stage, presenting Vietnam's most remarkable cultural and artistic shows. Owning a deep historical meaning along with significant artistic and cultural value, the Opera House still stands as a symbol of Vietnam's abundant heritage and artistic renaissance.

![An iconic landmark since the early 20th century, the Hanoi Opera House was a center for elite gatherings (Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/an-iconic-landmark-since-the-early-20th-century-the-hanoi-opera-house-was-a-center-for-elite.png)

_An iconic landmark since the early 20th century, the Hanoi Opera House was a center for elite gatherings_ _(Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)_

![A magnificent symbol of French colonial architecture, the Hanoi Opera House stands in the heart of the city (Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/a-magnificent-symbol-of-french-colonial-architecture-the-hanoi-opera-house-stands-in-the-heart-of.png)

_A magnificent symbol of French colonial architecture, the Hanoi Opera House stands in the heart of the city_ _(Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)_

## 3\. The Timeless Architectural Charm of Hanoi Opera House

The Hanoi Opera House is an architectural masterpiece where French neoclassical beauty intertwines with Vietnamese cultural influences. Its magnificent facade and luxurious interior, spanning three distinct floors, create a harmonious and impressive whole.

### 3.1. The First Floor

The first floor impresses with its spacious lobby, marble flooring, and intricate wall carvings, reflecting European sophistication. Rows of plush red seats in the auditorium provide excellent views of the stage. With a seating capacity of nearly 600, it ensures an intimate yet grand performance experience.

![A view of the first-floor seating area, showcasing elegant wooden chairs, golden decor (Source: Wyndham Thanh Thuy)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/a-view-of-the-first-floor-seating-area-showcasing-elegant-wooden-chairs-golden-decor.png)

_A view of the first-floor seating area, showcasing elegant wooden chairs, golden decor_ _(Source: Wyndham Thanh Thuy)_

![The grand entrance of the Hanoi Opera House’s first floor, featuring majestic columns (Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-grand-entrance-of-the-hanoi-opera-house-s-first-floor-featuring-majestic-columns.png)

_The grand entrance of the Hanoi Opera House’s first floor, featuring majestic columns_ _(Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)_

### 3.2. The Second Floor

The second floor offers a refined viewing experience with elegantly arranged balcony seats, providing a panoramic view of the stage. This level features the Mirror Chamber, an opulent hall adorned with gilded moldings and large mirrors, often used for official receptions and art exhibitions. The intricate ceiling details and warm lighting add to its sophisticated charm. From here, guests can fully immerse themselves in the grandeur of every performance.

![The second floor of the Hanoi Opera House features luxurious seating with a perfect view of the stage (Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-second-floor-of-the-hanoi-opera-house-features-luxurious-seating-with-a-perfect-view-of-the.png)

_The second floor of the Hanoi Opera House features luxurious seating with a perfect view of the stage_ _(Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)_

![The Mirror Room, a lavishly decorated space with grand chandeliers and elegant mirrors (Source: NOTES/ Triệu Chiến)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-mirror-room-a-lavishly-decorated-space-with-grand-chandeliers-and-elegant-mirrors.jpeg)

_The Mirror Room, a lavishly decorated space with grand chandeliers and elegant mirrors__(Source: NOTES/ Triệu Chiến)_

### 3.3. The Third Floor

The third floor offers a more private and elevated view of the stage, ideal for those who enjoy a panoramic perspective. Its design features elegant balconies with intricate railings, adding a touch of sophistication. Though seating is more limited, the cozy atmosphere enhances the audience’s focus on performances. This floor is often reserved for VIP guests and special occasions.

![A view of the third floor inside the Hanoi Opera House, featuring elegant balconies and classic French-style decor (Source: Tiền Phong)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/a-view-of-the-third-floor-inside-the-hanoi-opera-house-featuring-elegant-balconies-and-classic.png)

_A view of the third floor inside the Hanoi Opera House, featuring elegant balconies and classic French-style decor_ _(Source: Tiền Phong)_

![The third-floor seating area is designed for an immersive theater experience (Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-third-floor-seating-area-is-designed-for-an-immersive-theater-experience.png)

_The third-floor seating area is designed for an immersive theater experience_ _(Source: Nhà Hát Lớn Hà Nội)_

## 4\. Must-See Art Performances at The Opera House

The Hanoi Opera House offers a diverse range of art performances, including live concerts, opera performances, and theatrical plays. Each show brings a unique cultural experience, showcasing both traditional and contemporary art forms. Below are the main types of performances you can enjoy:

- **Live concerts**: These include tribute concerts honoring renowned musicians and traditional Vietnamese opera performances, and contemporary music events. One must-watch concert, though, is the Vietnam National Symphony Orchestra's Memorial Concert – an unmissable event that promises to bring profound musical experiences and emotional moments through each note to the audience.
- **Opera performances**: Featuring symphony concerts, instrumental performances, ballet shows, and opera singing events that highlight both local and international masterpieces. A notable example is the Vietnam National Opera and its famous ballet "Swan Lake" that captivates audiences worldwide with its romantic beauty, Tchaikovsky's timeless music, and the dancers’ exquisite technique.
- **Theatrical plays**: From traditional Vietnamese drama to modern stage productions, these plays bring stories to life with captivating performances. A standout option is the Vietnamese adaptation of Luu Quang Vu, a towering figure in Vietnamese theater. These performances often present moving and meaningful stories about the Vietnamese people and everyday life in Vietnam.

**_Note_**_: Show schedules and ticket prices may vary. Visitors can check the latest updates on the_[_official website_](https://hanoioperahouse.org.vn/chuong-trinh-bieu-dien/)_._

![A captivating performance inside the Hanoi Opera House, Swan Lake captivates many audiences with its romantic beauty (Source: Vietnam National Opera & Ballet)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/a-captivating-performance-inside-the-hanoi-opera-house-swan-lake-captivates-many-audiences-with-its.png)

_A captivating performance inside the Hanoi Opera House, Swan Lake captivates many audiences with its romantic beauty_ _(Source: Vietnam National Opera & Ballet)_

## 5\. Essential Tips for Visiting The Hanoi Opera House

When visiting the Hanoi Opera House, it’s essential to follow certain guidelines to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience. Here are some important tips for your visit:

- **Keep your phone on silent and avoid recording**: Filming, taking photos, or making noise during performances is strictly prohibited to respect the artists and other guests.
- **Arrive 15 - 30 minutes early**: Seats fill up quickly, and guests arriving more than 15 minutes after the show begins will not be allowed entry. Arriving early ensures you find your seat comfortably.
- **No smoking and outside food or drinks**: To maintain cleanliness and preserve the elegant atmosphere, food, drinks, and smoking are not permitted inside the theater.
- **Avoid making noise, especially with children**: Be mindful of your surroundings and keep conversations low. If bringing children, ensure they remain quiet so as not to disturb other guests.

![Visitors should arrive early to secure a good seat and enjoy the best view of the performances (Source: Vietnam National Opera & Ballet)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/visitors-should-arrive-early-to-secure-a-good-seat-and-enjoy-the-best-view-of-the-performances.png)

_Visitors should arrive early to secure a good seat and enjoy the best view of the performances_ _(Source: Vietnam National Opera & Ballet)_

## 6\. Top Attractions near Hanoi Opera House

If you're visiting Hanoi Opera House, take the opportunity to explore nearby cultural and historical landmarks. Here are some must-see attractions just a short distance away.

### 6.1. Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple

Located just 500 meters from the Hanoi Opera House, Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple are easily accessible for a **5 - 7 minutes walk**. Along the way, you'll have the opportunity to admire the graceful The Huc Bridge leading to Ngoc Son Temple. Visitors can take a relaxing stroll around the lake, enjoy the vibrant street life, or simply sit by the water and soak in the serene atmosphere.

Hoan Kiem Lake is one of Hanoi’s most iconic landmarks, best known for the Turtle Tower located on a small islet at its center. The tower not only adds to the lake’s picturesque beauty but also holds deep historical significance as it commemorates the legend of the magical sword returned to the Golden Turtle God, a tale that symbolizes Vietnamese patriotism and resistance.

Right in the heart of the lake, Ngoc Son Temple is a must-visit historical site connected by The Huc Bridge. This beautifully preserved temple is dedicated to General Tran Hung Dao, a national hero, and features stunning traditional Vietnamese architecture. Inside, you'll find ancient artifacts and altars that tell the story of Vietnam’s history.

![The bridge is designed in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, with rows of gilded wooden pillars and curved tiled roofs (Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-bridge-is-designed-in-the-traditional-vietnamese-architectural-style-with-rows-of-gilded-wooden.png)

_The bridge is designed in the traditional Vietnamese architectural style, with rows of gilded wooden pillars and curved tiled roofs_ _(Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)_

![The space inside the temple is divided into many areas with worship statues, murals and unique decorative details (Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-space-inside-the-temple-is-divided-into-many-areas-with-worship-statues-murals-and-unique.png)

_The space inside the temple is divided into many areas with worship statues, murals and unique decorative details_ _(Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)_

For those interested in exploring more of Hanoi's spiritual heritage, [Tran Quoc Pagoda](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/travel/travel-guide/tran-quoc-pagoda), Vietnam's oldest Buddhist temple dating back to the 6th century, offers another fascinating glimpse into the city's religious architecture and can be easily reached from this central location.

### 6.2. Hanoi St. Joseph Cathedral

Located **1.2km** from Hanoi Opera House, St. Joseph Cathedral is one of Hanoi’s most remarkable historical sites. Built in 1886, it is the oldest church in the city, showcasing a neo-Gothic architectural style inspired by Notre-Dame de Paris. The cathedral features two towering spires, intricate stained glass windows, and an ancient altar, creating a solemn yet majestic atmosphere.

Visitors can admire the grand façade, step inside to experience its peaceful ambiance, or explore the lively café culture surrounding the area. To reach the cathedral, you can take a 10-minute walk along Trang Thi Street or opt for a short taxi or cyclo ride. This is a must-visit destination for those interested in Hanoi’s rich history and architectural beauty.

![The soaring bell towers, pointed arches and stained glass windows create an unique architectural picture, bearing a strong Gothic imprint (Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-soaring-bell-towers-pointed-arches-and-stained-glass-windows-create-an-unique-architectural.png)

_The soaring bell towers, pointed arches and stained glass windows create an unique architectural picture, bearing a strong Gothic imprint_ _(Source: VIET NAM NATIONAL AUTHORITY OF TOURISM)_

![The large altar is elaborately decorated and the statues of saints are intricately carved (Source: Giáo Xứ Chính Tòa Hà Nội - Tổng Giáo Phận Hà Nội)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-large-altar-is-elaborately-decorated-and-the-statues-of-saints-are-intricately-carved.png)

_The large altar is elaborately decorated and the statues of saints are intricately carved_ _(Source: Giáo Xứ Chính Tòa Hà Nội - Tổng Giáo Phận Hà Nội)_

Architecture enthusiasts might also appreciate [Voi Phuc Temple](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/travel/travel-guide/voi-phuc-temple), another significant religious site that showcases traditional Vietnamese temple design and adds to the diverse spiritual landscape of the capital.

### 6.3. Hanoi Old Quarter

Just a short **1.5km** journey from Hanoi Opera House, the Hanoi Old Quarter is a lively and historic area that captures the essence of the city's past. With winding streets, ancient houses, and traditional craft shops, this neighborhood offers a glimpse into Hanoi’s rich heritage. Each street has its own specialty, from handcrafted goods to local delicacies, making it a paradise for explorers.

Visitors can stroll through the bustling alleys, savor authentic Vietnamese street food like pho and banh mi, or enjoy the city's vibrant nightlife at cozy cafes and bars. To get to the Old Quarter, you can take a leisurely 15-minute walk, rent a bicycle, or catch a taxi or cyclo for a quick and scenic ride. It’s a must-visit for those wanting to experience Hanoi’s authentic charm.

![The elegance and nostalgia of the day are replaced by the charming, graceful beauty of the night (Source: Visit Vietnam - The Official Tourism Website of Vietnam)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/the-elegance-and-nostalgia-of-the-day-are-replaced-by-the-charming-graceful-beauty-of-the-night.png)

_The elegance and nostalgia of the day are replaced by the charming, graceful beauty of the night_ _(Source: Visit Vietnam - The Official Tourism Website of Vietnam)_

![Hanoi Old Quarter is bustling with many souvenir shops, cafés, and restaurants (Source: Visit Vietnam - The Official Tourism Website of Vietnam)](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/content/dam/legacy-site-assets/SEO-images/2025%20SEO/Thay%20Anh%20Traffic%20Tieng%20Anh/hanoi%20opera%20house/hanoi-old-quarter-is-bustling-with-many-souvenir-shops-cafes-and-restaurants.png)

_Hanoi Old Quarter is bustling with many souvenir shops, cafés, and restaurants_ _(Source: Visit Vietnam - The Official Tourism Website of Vietnam)_

For visitors with more time to explore beyond the city center, the renowned [Perfume Pagoda Hanoi](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/travel/travel-guide/perfume-pagoda) complex offers a spiritual journey through Vietnam's most important Buddhist pilgrimage site, perfectly complementing your cultural exploration of the capital.

**_Hanoi Opera House_**_is a remarkable destination for those who love culture, history, and the arts. With its stunning architecture and world-class performances, it offers a unique experience in the heart of Hanoi. When planning_[_what to do in Hanoi_](https://www.vietnamairlines.com/au/en/plan-book/travel/travel-guide/what-to-do-in-hanoi)_, don't miss the chance to explore this cultural gem alongside the city's other remarkable attractions that showcase the perfect blend of historical significance and modern vibrancy._
